739020201.text: I'd like to know about Rukkhashava Mushrooms...

739020202.text: Rukkhashava Mushrooms are great stuff! You know by the name that they must be something amazing growing only on old trees.

739020203.text: I think... uh, they can serve as cooking ingredients, herbs... well, and maybe fertilizer?

739020204.text: Well, I'm not sure. All I know is that as long as the Akademiya needs it, I can always make money from it.

739020205.text: The only thing I do know is that it's a great ingredient for cooking. Here are some for you. Take a try.
